mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( id, password, name, gender, birth, mail, phone, address, regist_day ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birth}, #{mail}, #{phone}, #{address}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, password, name, gender, birth, mail, phone, address, regist_day FROM member ORDER BY regist_day DESC
SELECT id, password, name, gender, birth, mail, phone, address, regist_day FROM member WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, mail = #{mail}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address} WHERE id = #{id}
